_meta.note: Remediation decisions applied to data/clinical-flags.json by apply_remediations.py. Each entry sets status/governing_standard/resolution/verdict on its flag key. status: open|proposed|fixed|accepted|deferred. 'fixed' = mechanical (unit/citation/coverage), 'proposed' = canonical value changed to recommendation pending clinician sign-off. Illustrative — NOT a clinical sign-off.
